content.name: Khaak Pressure
content.description:
The Kha'ak in X4 are a mining alarm, not an enemy. They watch the sectors within three gate jumps of one of their hives, add up how much ore, silicon and nividium is pulled out of each one, and when a sector's score crosses fifty thousand they drop an outpost on it. Every one of those numbers is tuned for a galaxy where you are not supposed to notice them much.
This mod turns three of them into sliders: how far a hive reaches, how much mining an outpost costs them, and how often mining an asteroid drops a swarm on your miner's head.
[h2]Settings[/h2] [list] [*][b]Hive reach[/b] - 3 to 10 gate jumps, vanilla 3. How far from a hive the Kha'ak watch sectors and may place an outpost. This is the setting that changes the game most: at 3 they are a local nuisance around eight fixed sectors, at 6 they reach most of the core worlds, at 10 they watch nearly the whole galaxy and any sector you mine seriously is a candidate. The cost is CPU - the vanilla evaluation walks every watched sector once a minute. [*][b]Outpost cost[/b] - 10 000 to 50 000 mining activity, vanilla 50 000. The mining pulled out of a single sector that triggers an outpost placement. Your own miners count double, so 50 000 is roughly 20 000 units of silicon, 28 600 of ore or 10 000 of nividium. At 10 000 that is a couple of full L miner runs. [*][b]Ambush chance multiplier[/b] - 1x to 100x, vanilla 1x. Scales the chance that mining an asteroid spawns a Kha'ak group. It only does anything in a sector that already holds a Kha'ak outpost; everywhere else the vanilla chance is zero no matter what this says. Inside such a sector the vanilla chance is 0.03 percent per mined unit at full activity, so high multipliers saturate on a large haul. [/list] Changes take effect on the next evaluation, with no reload. Moving the reach slider also rebuilds the watched sector set immediately - vanilla itself only does that when a Kha'ak station is created or destroyed, so without it a wider reach would sit idle until the next hive died.
[h2]Where to change them[/h2] With SirNukes Mod Support APIs installed: [b]Options - Extension Options - Khaak Pressure[/b].
Without that API the mod runs off the constants at the top of md/drjele_khaak_pressure.xml, re-read on every savegame load - editing one and reloading is enough, no new game is needed. Any other mod or cheat menu can also override them at runtime through the globals $DrJeleKhaakHiveGateRange, $DrJeleKhaakOutpostThreshold and $DrJeleKhaakSpawnChanceFactor.
[h2]One place where the default is not vanilla[/h2] The floor a sector needs to be a candidate at all is held at half the trigger. Vanilla's ratio is 0.8 - it pairs a trigger of 50 000 with a floor of 40 000. So even with both sliders at the top, the pool of sectors an outpost may land in is wider here than in the stock game.
That does not make outposts appear more often, since the trigger itself is unchanged. It changes where they land: outposts spread further out from whichever sector you are mining hardest, instead of concentrating on it. One line in drjele_khaak_pressure.xml puts the vanilla ratio back.
[h2]Dependencies[/h2] [list] [*][b]X4: Foundations 9.00[/b] - required. [*][b]SirNukes Mod Support APIs[/b] - optional, and only for the in-game options menu. Everything works without it. [*]No DLC required. [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] Works on an existing savegame. The two applied settings are written straight into the vanilla Kha'ak manager's own variables rather than patched into a cue that has already run, so they reach a game already in progress and cannot collide with another mod's XPath. Only the ambush multiplier needs a patch, and its selector matches exactly one node.
In a Timelines scenario, a tutorial or the workshop map the mod stays completely inert.
Removing it: the values already written stay in the savegame, because they are the vanilla manager's own variables. They reset on a new game, and can be put back at any time by reinstalling with the vanilla numbers in the configuration cue.
Source and full documentation: https://github.com/drjele/x4-khaak-pressure

text.name: Khaak Pressure
text.description: Sliders for how far the Kha'ak reach and how hard they push: the gate range a hive can place outposts within, the mining activity an outpost costs, and a multiplier on the chance mining spawns a Kha'ak group. Works on an existing savegame.
